title: Eight Sleep rating
description: A stacked star rating: a big condensed figure (4.6), a row of five small stars filled to the score, and a short count line under it. Centered, compact, foreground-coloured.
notes: the figure uses the theme variable --eightsleep-figures when present, else the display face
name: eightsleep-rating

props.name: score
props.description: the score out of five, e.g. 4.6

props.name: caption
props.description: the line under the stars, e.g. "38,000+ reviews"

props.name: label
props.description: screen-reader text for the stars, e.g. "4.6 out of 5 stars"
